name: goodix-gxfp-protocol
description: Protocol notes and tools for the Goodix **GXFP5187** and **GXFP51A7** SPI fingerprint sensors (Huawei MateBook X Pro `MACH-WX9` and MateBook 13 2019 `WRT-WX9`). These are the sensors driven by [libfprint-goodixtls](https://github.com/Sigfrodr/libfprint-goodixtls).
